title: What It Actually Looks Like to Carry Your Family and Still Not Play Savior
caption:
A lot of guys become the one their family calls. The bills, the crisis, the brother who keeps getting in trouble. And that's a good thing. A man of God goes first into the cost.

But you were never meant to be their savior. You can carry the load without carrying the outcome. Answer the phone. Show up. Pray before you rescue. And let them watch you lean on Christ, so they learn where real strength comes from.

"Cast all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you." 1 Peter 5:7

Save this for the next time the phone rings.

theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
